services.name: Jetski Rentals
services.desc: Embark On an Exhilarating 26-mile Round Trip Journey Through the Waters of Maderia Beach & Johns Pass. Surrounded By Uninhabited Islands, Where Every Twist and Turn Promises an Unforgettable Experience. Our Hour and a Half Dolphin Jet Ski Tour Offers the Perfect Blend Of Adrenaline-Pumping Excitement And Breathtaking natural beauty. We Leave From The Cambria Hotel. Freestyle ride options are available at our Clearwater location. Visit WeGetYouWetWatersports for more information. We strongly recommend making reservations in advance. Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your scheduled appointment. All drivers are required to leave a government-issued ID for the duration of the rental;

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and embark on a leisurely adventure along the stunning coastline of Pinellas Park. With our pontoon boat rentals, you can chart your own course, soak up the sun, and create unforgettable memories with family and friends. Dolphins Can Also Be Seen Following the Boat Or Playing In the Sun. Our pontoon boats offer ample space for up to 10 passengers, making them perfect for families, groups, or couples seeking a relaxing day on the water. Kick back and relax in plush, cushioned seating as you cruise along the coastline. Whether you're soaking up the sun or enjoying a picnic lunch, our boats are designed with your comfort in mind. blurb: Ocean Fun Rentals offers pontoon boat and jet ski rentals in Madeira Beach, Florida, including captain-led or self-guided pontoon excursions and a guided Dolphin Jet Ski Tour. Guests can explore local waterways, sandbars, and islands, and may see dolphins, rays, and sea turtles. Reservations are recommended and deposits are required.
